up: Retrieve activity details for the compound CHEMBL941 (Imatinib) and all its salts. Identify the parent compound and all related salts using the molecule_hierarchy table by matching where the parent_molregno corresponds to CHEMBL941. For these compounds, return all IC50 bioactivity records (standard_type = 'IC50', standard_units = 'nM') against the target CHEMBL1936 (Mast/stem cell growth factor receptor Kit). For each matching activity record, return the following fields: compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi (preferring pubmed_id if available, else doi), assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, and target_organism. Do not limit the number of rows.
sql: WITH target_set AS (SELECT tid FROM target_dictionary WHERE chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1936'), parent AS (SELECT molregno FROM molecule_dictionary WHERE chembl_id = 'CHEMBL941'), related_mols AS (SELECT molregno FROM parent UNION ALL SELECT mh.molregno FROM parent p JOIN molecule_hierarchy mh ON mh.parent_molregno = p.molregno) SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id AS compound_chembl_id, cs.canonical_smiles, cr.compound_key, COALESCE(CAST(d.pubmed_id AS TEXT), d.doi) AS pubmed_id_or_doi, ass.description AS assay_description, a.standard_type, a.standard_relation, a.standard_value, a.standard_units, a.activity_comment, td.chembl_id AS target_chembl_id, td.pref_name AS target_name, td.organism AS target_organism FROM activities a JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id JOIN target_set ts ON ass.tid = ts.tid JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid JOIN related_mols rm ON a.molregno = rm.molregno JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno LEFT JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno LEFT JOIN compound_records cr ON a.record_id = cr.record_id LEFT JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id WHERE a.standard_type = 'IC50' AND a.standard_units = 'nM'
